reply_text:
I posted the ticket list as a reply in #strategic-pod, under your message.

It lists five ticket references, each with its source:

1. #8841 (Mateo, Allentown/Newark kiosk issues): #strategic-pod on 1 Jul says it was closed. The 5/4 and 9/30 digests show it open, with different sites and symptoms.
2. #PD-8841 (Allentown missed carrier check-ins): 4/27 digest. It does not say whether this is the same ticket as #8841.
3. #PD-4418 (Carrier_Dwell_Summary timestamp export, Dock Door 9): 9/15/2025 digest. That digest says "the account Nadia runs" without naming Vantorre, so I've taken it as Vantorre Group. Please confirm.
4. INC-4821 (Hartford gate kiosk outage, 3 Aug): #inc-vtg-hartford.
5. VT-55120 (root cause of the Hartford kiosk outage): #inc-vtg-hartford, 14 Oct.

The 8/3 digest covers the Hartford Sev 1 but gives no ticket number. The other digests mention Vantorre without a ticket number.

I read only the three sources you named. I did not check the accounts/ ticket folders, so the list may be incomplete. The #8841 conflict is worth checking in the ticket system before the steering committee.
